prompt: Dry Runs, Edge Cases and Debugging: What is the purpose of a dry run on a small input?

options.text: It proves every implementation is correct without any tests.
options.explain: A definition cannot replace a test or a trace of an actual implementation.

options.text: To trace stored values and compare them with the intended output.
options.explain: A written trace reveals the first step where the mental model and program diverge.

options.text: It replaces input constraints with one fixed array size.
options.explain: Input bounds are part of the problem and do not disappear when a technique is named.

options.text: It makes the compiler choose the algorithm while the program runs.
options.explain: The programmer chooses the algorithm; a compiler translates the written steps.

reveal.solution: A written trace reveals the first step where the mental model and program diverge.
